title: Airbyte Normalization Failures
dataSources: Airbyte API job/connection status (`airbyte:job`), worker logs (`airbyte:worker`), and normalization logs.
app: Airbyte API (`/api/v1/jobs`, `/api/v1/connections`) and Airbyte worker/server logs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=airbyte:job job_type="sync"
| search (attempt_status="failed" AND failure_origin="normalization") OR failure_type="normalization"
| stats count as failures by connection_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Isolates Airbyte sync failures whose origin is the normalization step, distinguishing dbt-normalization breakage from source/destination errors.
value: Normalization failures leave raw data landed but un-modelled, so partial data appears without a full failure; isolating them speeds the right fix.
implementation: Ingest Airbyte job events including failure origin; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on normalization failures for key connections.
visualization: Table of connection by normalization failures, timechart.
grandmaExplanation: We catch when the data-tidying step of a sync fails so half-finished data does not get mistaken for complete.
